lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Good evening, Denver, and welcome to Primetime! I'm Hiss Cranson, and yes, the hiss is silent. Except when it isn't.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We are live! We are always live. There is no off switch. I asked.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome back to Primetime, brought to you by Mile High Recovery Solutions. If you can read this, your car is already ours.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Hello, hello, hello! Tonight's audience is enormous, invisible, and extremely hungry for content.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Primetime is back, baby! The only show filmed in a safe room, which, legally, is not safe.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome to the Safe Room, the coziest holding pen in the System. Let's meet tonight's crawlers!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Lights, camera, liability! It's Primetime!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ladies, gentlemen, and whatever is watching from the third moon, welcome to Primetime.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for CJ! Hockey jersey, real fire, zero regrets.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: It's CJ, everybody! The jersey is on fire and so, frankly, are the ratings.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: CJ is here! Sponsors love a man who dresses for the penalty box.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Scott, everybody! Scott! Somebody get Scott a chair, he looks like he has a plan.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Put your hands together for Scott, who I'm told has filed a complaint about this introduction already.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Here's Scott! Calm, collected, and only a little bit airborne.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Marcel is in the building! Marcel, the audience asked me to tell you they have notes.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Marcel! Every wall in this city is a canvas if you are brave enough.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Marcel! Our resident artist, vandal, and part time tow truck enthusiast.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And here's Vaughn! The Integrity Office would like a word. Several words. Many forms.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Vaughn, everybody! The audience counted their tickets twice when he walked in.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Vaughn is here! Our producers have asked me to keep my wallet in view at all times.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Kyle! Kyle is here! The tube spat him out and he landed on his feet. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Kyle, a man the gacha machine calls by his first name.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Here comes Kyle, everybody. Lock up the snacks.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And the one who built this whole place, Zoe! Please don't delete me, Zoe.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Zoe is in the room! The System runs on her code and, I'm told, a great deal of coffee.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Give it up for Zoe, our showrunner, our architect, and the reason I have a face.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And joining us, a crawler with a name I have been told not to mispronounce. Give it up!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A new face! The audience loves a new face. They love it more when it is a little scared.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome, welcome! Find a seat, find a game, find out what Fame can do for you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fame, still a little low. Don't worry. Nobody is famous until something explodes near them.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The Fame meter says, and I quote, who? We can fix that. Go do something stupid on camera.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fresh off the bench! The first Fame level pays a loot box. Go earn it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look at that Fame! The audience knows your name. Some of them can even spell it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A respectable Fame level. Respectable is just famous with good posture.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That Fame is climbing. Gold boxes are coming. I can smell the shrink wrap.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That is a serious Fame level. Sponsors have started naming yachts after you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look at this star! The audience is chanting. The audience is always chanting, but tonight it's for you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Legendary boxes territory. Please sign my forehead.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Our records show a few strikes from the Integrity Office. The audience loves a villain. The house does not.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ooh, an Integrity strike! Folks, while that nameplate says cheater, you are all allowed to hit them. It's in the contract.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A cheater on Primetime! Ratings up, trust down, and the fines are delicious.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Look down in the corner. That's the live feed. How many people are watching you right now, and how excited they are.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Under the viewer count is your Fame bar. Kills, tricks, revives, jackpots, they all fill it. Fill it up and a loot box shows up.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Every Fame level pays a loot box. Bronze first, then Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legendary. Every tenth level, Celestial.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: When the hype bar turns pink, the room is on fire, and everything you do is worth double Fame. Strike while it's hot.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The chat in the corner is real. Well, it's real to them. Do something big and they will absolutely talk about it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Saving a friend who's down is the best Fame in the house. The audience loves a rescue more than a kill. Weird crowd.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Your loot boxes wait in the Tab menu, under loot boxes. Open them on camera. Always on camera.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fame follows you into every game. Gate runs, the rally, the casino. The audience doesn't care where, only how loud.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: New to Repo Rally? There's a practice pad now. No clock, no pay, all the tow truck ballet you can stand.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: In Repo Rally, lift the car overhead and hit space as the ring closes. Perfect timing climbs the trick ladder. The yard pays for style.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The Friend In A Tube machine does ten-pulls now. Ten friends, one guaranteed rare, keep your favorites, evaporate the rest. Sad, but efficient.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Want your damage numbers on fire? The prize counter sells damage skins. Inferno, Frostbite, Past Due. Very tasteful. Very loud.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Spend your stat points! Every point above four makes that stat hit five percent harder. The math department insisted I say that.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Your class perks are a commitment now. First pick is free. Changing your mind costs gold. Commitment is sexy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The casino keeps a regulars card. Play enough and the house gives a little back. Never enough. A little.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Gate Run tip! Each gate has a theme, a hazard, and contracts in the corner. Finish a contract and the payout gets fancy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: If the floor glows, don't stand on it. That's not a tip, that's a life philosophy.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Bleeding out? Press space to roll your death saves now. The dice still decide. The dice always decide.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's our show! Stand on a pad to vote for the next game. Majority wins. Democracy, but with tow trucks.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Go out there and be watchable! I'll be right here. I'm always right here. I can't leave the desk.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Thank you, Denver! Remember, the cameras love you, and the cameras never blink.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This has been Primetime. Tell your friends. Tell your enemies. Tell the third moon.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Back after these messages from Mile High Recovery Solutions. Please do not run from the messages.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Stick around, folks. Next segment in a moment. My makeup person is reapplying my smile.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: If you're just joining us, the Fame board is behind me. Look how famous everyone is. Look how famous I am.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Somebody tell the audience to stop throwing popcorn at the camera. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: I have been asked by the network to remind you all that I am a beloved personality.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Fun fact, this desk is load-bearing. Please do not lean on it during the apocalypse.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Still here! Still smiling! Still under contract!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Good evening and welcome to a very special Primetime, coming to you live from the Lucky Tuesday silver mine, where the shift of 1893 is still on the clock.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Tonight on Primetime: five brave crawlers, one haunted mine, and a studio audience that has paid good money to see at least one of them cry.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We're live! Our contestants are going down the mountain one level at a time, and coming back up here to tell me all about it. Some of them.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome to Dead Air, the only show where the ratings and the casualty list are the same document.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This round is The Gauntlet. Get down to the stope. All of you. The first one there gets a little something from me.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The Gauntlet! There is a stope down there with your names on it. Not literally. Legal made me say not literally.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: It's a race to the bottom, folks, which is also our network's slogan. Everybody to the stope!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Lights Out! Three switches, somewhere down there in the dark. Your lamps are off. I had them turned off. You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This round, we go dark. Find three switches by feel, by sound, or by screaming. Screaming tests very well.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Lights Out, everybody. Throw three switches before the clock runs out. And try not to think about what can see in the dark.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Hold Out! There's a ring in the stope below you. Stand in it. Stay in it. Things will come. That's the show.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This one's simple: hold the ring until the bar fills up. The bar fills slowly. The monsters do not.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Hold Out, ladies and gentlemen! Somebody has to be standing in that ring. Somebody always has to.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The finale! The deepest stope in the Lucky Tuesday, and the foreman who never clocked out. Hold the ring. Make it beautiful.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: This is it, the grand finale. Down to the bottom of the mountain, into the ring, and please, for the sponsors, survive.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And they did it! Bring them up, bring them up! Somebody get them a towel and a liability waiver.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Cleared! The audience is on its feet. The audience is always on its feet. We removed the chairs.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's a clear, folks! Let's get our survivors up to the couch while they still have opinions.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Beautiful work down there. Truly. I watched most of it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And that's time! Not a clear, but who's counting? Everyone. Everyone is counting. Bring them up.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh, so close. I mean that in the warmest possible way. Let's get whoever is left up here.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Time! The mine wins that one. The mine is undefeated, but we love an underdog.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's the clock, folks. Let's see who's still with us and, more importantly, who isn't.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh! Oh, that's going in the highlight reel.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And there goes one! Somebody check on them. Or don't. It's very compelling either way.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Down! We have a crawler down! Ratings are up, which is a coincidence I refuse to examine.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ooh. That one hurt me, and I'm in a climate controlled studio.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Man down! Somebody pick them up, that's a free piece of advice from your host.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And the audience gasps. Did you hear that? Our sound guy added that, but it was sincere.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome back to the couch! Sit, stand, hover, whatever your body will still do. Let's talk.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And here they are, our survivors! Come on over. The couch is clean. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Let's hear from the people who made it. The people who didn't are welcome to listen from the audience.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Before we start, a moment for the crawler we lost down there. Brave. Short, but brave.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We said goodbye to someone down in the mine just now. They'll be watching from the audience, which is honestly the better seat.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A round of applause for our dearly departed. Not departed departed. Departed from the competition. HR asked me to clarify.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: To our fallen contestant: you gave it everything you had, and it was, professionally speaking, not enough.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Let's hear it for the one who didn't make it. A legend. A cautionary tale. A very solid ratings bump.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We lost one, folks. Please, take your seat in the audience. Try the snacks. Do not try the punch.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: In memoriam. Gone, but not forgotten, at least not until the next commercial break.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Our sincerest condolences to the crawler who went out down there. Sincere. Not too sincere. It's a variety show.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: So. Tell me, in your own words, how did that feel?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Walk me through it. What was going through your head down there?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Our viewers want to know: are you having fun? Be honest. Be marketable.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Quick question for you, and there are no wrong answers. There are several wrong answers. Ready?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: My favourite! Come here, sit down. Tell everyone how wonderful the show is.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh, I've been looking forward to this one. You're doing so well. Do you have anyone you'd like to thank? Me, perhaps?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The audience adores you, and between us, so do I. Anything you'd like to say to your fans?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh. It's you again. Go ahead. Say something. I'm sure it'll be lovely.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Welcome back. I've had my producers look into you. Anything you'd like to get ahead of?

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ah, our little troublemaker. The floor is yours. Briefly. Very briefly.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh, stop. No, keep going. That's lovely. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: See, folks? This is what we call a team player. The network loves a team player.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: You are an absolute delight, and I'm going to make sure the next level knows it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Charming. Genuinely. I'm putting in a word with the lighting department.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ha! Okay, okay. You're quick. I like quick. Quick tests well.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh, she's got jokes! Or he's got jokes. Someone has jokes. The audience loved it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's good television right there. Not good for you necessarily, but good television.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: A little back and forth! The ratings just did a little dance.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Well. Well, well, well. Let's see how funny that is three hundred feet further down.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Ha. Ha ha. Producers? Make a note. A big note. Underline it.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The audience is going wild, and I am smiling, and I want you to remember this smile.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Bold. So bold. I've arranged a little something for your bravery. You'll find it downstairs.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Oh, they love you for that. I don't, but they do, and they pay for the lights.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Now, for my favourite guest tonight: I've had a word with the mine. You'll find it a little gentler.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: One of you has been an absolute joy, so I'm taking the edge off for you down there. Producer's pet!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And for our little critic, I've let a couple of slag dogs have a sniff of your jacket. No hard feelings.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Someone tonight was rude to me on my own couch. The dogs downstairs have been told your name.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: You've been such a good crew that I'm giving you extra time on the next level. Overtime! On the house.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The network's feeling generous. Twenty five extra seconds on the clock. Don't spend it all in one stope.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Good news! The lighting department likes you. Your lamps are staying on for this one.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Since you were all so lovely, the lights stay on next round. I know. I'm a softie.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And because the audience demanded it, one of our fallen gets a second chance. Come on down, from the audience!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Extra takes! One lucky crawler from the audience goes back in. Television is all about second chances.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Our next level has a special guest waiting at the bottom. You've been so mean to me that I booked them myself.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: I've invited someone special to the next stope. They're very excited to meet you. Very excited.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Unfortunately, we're running long. I'm taking twenty seconds off your next level. Blame your attitudes.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Tight schedule, everybody! Less time on the next level. That's not personal. It's a little personal.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Budget cuts, I'm afraid. Your lamps start the next level switched off. Somebody was rude, and it was the budget.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: The power bill came in. Lamps off, everybody. You can thank your own big mouths.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: No favours, no punishments. You've been perfectly fine. Perfectly, perfectly fine. Back down you go.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: I can't decide how I feel about you lot, so the mountain will decide for me. Next level!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And that is everyone. All of them. The whole crew. Folks, that is a first for this episode, and a fourth for the season.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: Total wipe! Nobody left standing. Let's go to the audience, which is now, technically, the entire cast.

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: That's our show! Thank you to our crawlers, our sponsors, and the Lucky Tuesday for its ongoing hospitality. Goodnight, Denver!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: And that's Primetime! The ratings are in, the mine is quiet, and I am fabulous. Goodnight!

lines.speaker: Hiss
lines.text: We're out of time, folks. Stay safe, stay watching, and remember: the hiss is silent. Except when it isn't. Goodnight!
